ledger: 00:00 - First small glass container filled with green olives is held over an empty large glass jar.
00:01 - 00:03 - Green olives are poured from the small glass container into the large glass jar, with dark purple olives appearing mid-air and filling the jar.
00:04 - 00:05 - Hand reaches to the right and retrieves a second small glass container filled with green olives.
00:06 - 00:08 - Second small glass container is tilted into the large glass jar; additional dark purple olives emerge during the pour.

findings.description: Green olives poured from the small glass container change color into dark purple olives while falling into the large jar, resulting in dark purple olives accumulating in a previously empty jar.
Green olives poured from the second small container spontaneously generate dark purple olives mid-pour that land inside the main jar.
